questions.prompt: What are the three steps of a group-by?
questions.explain: Split the table by key, apply a summary to each piece, combine the answers into one result.

questions.prompt: What does df.groupby("city") on its own return?
choices: A grouped object that has computed nothing yet
questions.explain: Nothing happens until you name the summary, which is why printing it is unhelpful.

questions.prompt: After groupby(...).mean(), where is the group key?
questions.explain: reset_index() or as_index=False puts it back as a column when you want a plain table.

questions.prompt: Why report the group size next to the group mean?
choices: A mean over two rows and one over two thousand are not comparable
questions.explain: The group with the striking average is very often the group with three rows in it.
